aluminum_surface_energy.name: Aluminum Surface Energy
aluminum_surface_energy.description: Calculate the surface energy of Aluminum in the given Miller index direction by removing periodic boundary conditions in that direction and computing the energy difference per unit area between the relaxed bulk and the relaxed slab configuration. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential and the following simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. Return the surface energy in eV/Å² units.

silicon_surface_energy.name: Silicon Surface Energy
silicon_surface_energy.description: Calculate the surface energy of Silicon in the given Miller index direction by removing periodic boundary conditions in that direction and computing the energy difference per unit area between the relaxed bulk and the relaxed slab configuration. Use the reaxff potential and the following simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 2 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. Return the surface energy in kcal/(mol Å²) units.
